title: Shandong Luyang Energy-Saving Materials Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Materials Manufacturer
content:
Shandong Luyang Energy-Saving Materials Co., Ltd. is a large Chinese energy-saving materials manufacturer founded in 1984 and publicly listed in 2006. In addition to its well-known ceramic-fiber and high-temperature insulation businesses, the company publicly states that it applies aerogel composite materials to power-battery and energy-storage thermal-protection systems.

Company Overview

Luyang is a major Chinese high-temperature insulation materials company with large-scale manufacturing, broad export reach, and long-running technical capabilities. Its new-energy battery business publicly references ceramic fiber, nano insulation, and aerogel composite materials used for thermal safety, fire protection, and energy-efficiency management.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China and more than 60 overseas markets.
  • Focus Areas: High-temperature insulation, energy-saving materials, EV battery thermal protection, energy-storage thermal safety, and industrial thermal management.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel composite materials for battery and energy-storage systems
  • Nano insulation sheets and related thermal-protection products
  • Ceramic-fiber paper and related high-temperature materials used in thermal-protection systems
  • Public Capacity: The company states overall annual capacity of nearly 600,000 tons of ceramic-fiber products; a separate aerogel-composite output figure is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed public pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Zibo, Shandong, China.
  • International Certifications: Public pages emphasize large-scale manufacturing, patents, and recognized enterprise technical capabilities; specific aerogel-related international certifications are not clearly listed on the reviewed pages.
  • Official Website: https://www.luyang.com/
